verdict.rationale: Canny has its own first-party docs page titled "Embed a Canny widget into your website" and documents a JavaScript SDK, so the product does ship an embeddable web widget. The pack shows only the page title, though, with no detail on the install method. missing for 10: evidence that install is a single script tag, evidence that no build step or bundler is required, the widget install snippet and configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed a feedback widget on my website with a single script tag and no build step

citations.quote: Embed a Canny widget into your website
Install our JavaScript SDK to identify your users.
